warnings: Pyramid hip roof (A-03 roof plan: slope all 4 sides, กระเบื้องพรีม่า ตราช้าง), roof edge 1.00 outside the grid all round (1', 3', A', C'). Members from the หมายเหตุ legend: ตะเฆ้สัน 2C-100x50x20x3.2 (heavy dash-dot-dot diagonals), จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00 (thin lines), แป เหล็กกล่อง 25x25x1.6 @0.50 (short dashes, drawn only inside the detail bubble), Truss T1 (long-dash line at y = 2.50).

The four hips meet at the apex x = 2.50, y = 2.50 (2', A'''' - the S-02 chains 0.50 + 2.50 each way). Hips are diagonal, so their spans are left unresolved (section 4), endpoints still on grid points.

Jack rafters and purlins carry no mark (element_id null, element_name_assigned) and are recorded as one area element each with their printed spacing, not as segments: the rafter ends land on the diagonal hips at points no dimension prints, and the E/W-face rafter lines are drawn at about 0.88 m spacing that matches no printed tick, so per-segment grid refs would be invented. Flagged not_segmented.
T1 is split at its two end supports (grids 1 and 3 per the TRUSS T1 elevation, which draws posts only at its ends); its 1.00 overhangs to 1' / 3' are top-chord-only segments.
C-section designations are recorded as 'C' / '2C' with keys d_mm, b_mm, lip_mm, t_mm (same mapping as houses 95 / 134). 'เหล็กกล่อง-25x25x1.6' is a square hollow section -> SHS.
